description.zh:
识别类型，取值：

- landmark：自定义地标。

- object：自定义物体。

- logo：自定义logo

- face：自定义人脸

- label：自定义标签
description.en:
The type of recognition algorithm. Valid values:

- landmark

- object

- logo

- face
The entity ID. If you set this parameter to ANY, the system queries by EntityName.

description.zh: 库ID，传入则精确查该库；支持传入列表，用","分割。
description.en: The library ID. If you specify this parameter, the system performs an exact match. You can specify multiple library IDs. Separate them with commas (,).
The number of entries per page.

title.zh: 获取自定义实体的识别样本列表
title.en: Retrieve the list of detection samples for a Custom entity

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口目前支持的地域为华北2（北京）、华东2（上海）、华东1（杭州）、华南1（深圳），其他地域暂不支持。

- 本接口的单用户 QPS 限制为 50 次/秒。超过限制，API 调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见 [QPS 限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This API is supported only in the China (Beijing), China (Shanghai), China (Hangzhou), and China (Shenzhen) regions.

- You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.
